item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":4,"rationale":"The President uses mandatory, present-tense proclamation language concerning specified federal lands, but this syntactically incomplete segment does not state what legal status or consequence is being proclaimed; that consequence appears only in segment 2.","evidence":"hereby proclaim that all lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the Government of the United States"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself immediately reserves the federal lands as a national monument and withdraws them from entry, sale, leasing, and other disposition; the accompanying agency-management instructions implement that present legal designation.","evidence":"are hereby set apart and reserved as the Fort Ord National Monument"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The Secretary of the Interior must later prepare and maintain a transportation plan whose required designations impose specified limits on motorized and mechanized vehicle use.","evidence":"motorized vehicle use shall be permitted only on designated roads"}]}
